evaluation_type: Independent public-cohort refits of Cox and pooled Kaplan–Meier plus the production daily LightGBM hazard training recipe on a smaller deterministic sample. All models use issue-time features and the same IPCW survival metrics as the synthetic evaluation. This is an external pipeline check, not a prospective result for the synthetic-trained deployed model.

cleaning.privacy: Customer and invoice identifiers are SHA-256 hashed in memory; output contains aggregates and no row-level data.

split.benchmark_sample_method: Deterministic SHA-256 sample stratified across the temporal train and test partitions; all unique invoices remain available as point-in-time client-history evidence.
split.lightgbm_sample_method: Deterministic SHA-256 temporal sample bounded at 1,000 invoices to run the production daily risk-row expansion and LightGBM training recipe.

caveats: Payment timing and customer mix differ from the synthetic USD/EUR/GBP demonstration data; public data includes USD and CAD.
The public benchmark is historical and limited to its source population and collection process.
The non-commercial license permits research evaluation; do not use the dataset as a commercial training source without separate rights review.
